verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "Ask Fellow" as a feature, suggesting a built-in assistant. The product's own AI also produces meeting summaries, suggested action items, decisions and minutes automatically. The MCP server only exposes Fellow data to external chatbots (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor), so it does not count as a built-in assistant. missing for 10: any documentation of what Ask Fellow does, evidence that users can delegate tasks or actions to it (beyond passive summarization), scope of its in-product capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
